## About
The Spencer Company is a horticultural management business serving commercial clients from the heart of Houston. Our work covers landscape management, seasonal color, landscape construction, irrigation, pest control and exterior holiday decorating.
Our mission is to provide a service that will delight our customers, develop our employees and enhance our environment. Keeping your landscape in topnotch condition is our number one concern.
Every custom landscape design addresses the soil preparation, water and light requirements needed for the landscape to perform well. For landscape pests, we use Integrated Pest Management (IPM) procedures so control measures are effective, safe and environmentally friendly.

## Services
- Landscape Design: A custom design using a variety of plants and landscape materials, planned around soil preparation, water and light requirements.
- Landscape Construction: Complex installations or simple renovations, including turf, tree, shrub and ground cover plantings, hardscape and landscape lighting.
- Landscape Management: Custom programs covering mowing, edging and trimming, plus fertilization and pruning to support the health of the whole landscape.
- Seasonal Color: Large beds around a monument sign or a few pots at the front door, designed, installed and managed with high quality annuals and perennials.
- Pest Control: Integrated Pest Management (IPM) procedures that aim for control measures that are effective, safe and environmentally friendly.
- Irrigation: Design, installation and ongoing management of irrigation systems by technicians trained in installation and repair.
- Erosion Control & Drainage
- Exterior Holiday Decorating: Decorative wreaths to custom lighting for commercial properties. We design, install, maintain, remove and store it for next season.
